newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gengold's Dale wary on gold hedging.
newsitem.headline: Gengold's Dale wary on gold hedging.

text.p: Gengold, the gold arm of South African mining house Gencor Ltd, said on Monday it did not plan to hedge any more gold in the near future despite a recent bounce in bullion to slightly better levels.
Gengold chairman Tom Dale told Reuters the bullion price was not sustainable at $300 an ounce and he thought it could recover to trade between $340 and $380 an ounce.
Asked whether Gengold would take advantage of a slight recovery in the gold price since Friday and hedge some production, Dale said:
"I don't think so. We're not natural hedgers. We look at the thing regularly on a weekly basis but we think our shareholders want exposure to volatility."
Asked what his outlook for the gold price was, Dale said:
"I don't think it's sustainable at $300. I would think it's rangebound between $340 and $380."
Dale said that Beatrix Mines Ltd was Gengold's only hedged gold operation and that it earned seven million rand from its hedging programme in the three months to end-June.
He said that with the gold price at current levels it was earning about a million rand a week.
Beatrix's June quarter distributable income slipped to 43.14 million rand from 49.14 million rand.
"The only operation that's hedged is Beatrix. Beatrix earned seven million rand in the quarter from its hedge and at the moment it's earning about a million rand a week," he said.
Dale said Gengold had hedged at Beatrix because it was one of the lowest cost producers in the industry and did not have the same production risk as other operations.

"My worst nightmare is going into a long-term hedge with Evander or St Helena and then you get a production dislocation and you can't deliver the gold you sold. Then you've got a real mess on your hands financially," he said.
Gengold announced earlier on Monday it had made a distributable profit of 60.65 million rand for the June quarter compared to 87.70 million rand in the rpeceding quarter.
Evander Gold Mines Ltd made 2.61 million rand compared to 32.81 million rand. St Helena Gold Mines Ltd made 14.91 million rand compared to 5.75 million rand.
